slides.title:
From Screen
to Stay
slides.subtitle: An AI-led, evidence-audited map of connected hospitality experiences.
slides.body: The in-room display is becoming an experience-orchestration layer connecting guest comfort, property operations, and ecosystem value.
slides.alt_text: HXG title slide with a preview of six capability-to-guest-outcome pathways.

slides.title: The screen is already a consequential touchpoint.
slides.subtitle: J.D. Power | 2026 North America Hotel Guest Satisfaction Index Study
slides.scope: North America, branded hotels, stays from May 2025 through May 2026. The sample is not every hotel room or every guest segment.
slides.body: Availability and use establish relevance - not causal satisfaction, loyalty, revenue, or a universal guest outcome.
slides.alt_text: J.D. Power evidence: 74 percent availability, 62 percent usage, and 44,787 branded hotel guests, with source scope and a causation caveat.

slides.title: Six capabilities. Six guest outcomes.
slides.body: Each one-to-one pathway uses the deliberately bounded verb can support. Select the evidence IDs in the live explorer to inspect confidence and limitations.
slides.alt_text: Six rows connect Cast from your device to Feel at home, Control room settings to Feel in control, Connect stay context to Feel recognized, Present content accessibly to Feel included, Protect sessions and data to Feel secure, and Request services and help to Feel supported.

slides.title: Human value first. Property value must be measured.

formulae.heading: Ancillary contribution
formulae.body: Occupied room nights x engagement x conversion x margin. Incrementality must be tested locally.

formulae.heading: Energy savings
formulae.body: Baseline spend x controllable share x verified reduction. No universal savings rate is claimed.

formulae.heading: Support savings
formulae.body: Remotely resolved incidents x avoided dispatch cost. Avoided visits must be measured.

slides.context: ENERGY STAR reports energy at about 6% of lodging operating costs and heating/cooling at almost 40% of electricity use. This is current agency guidance, not new 2026 measurement.
slides.alt_text: Human outcomes flow through measurement into three property-specific value scenarios for ancillary contribution, energy, and remote support.

slides.title: Value changes depending on who is looking.
slides.context: Nearly $805B in projected 2026 U.S. hotel guest spending is economic context - not revenue attributable to in-room screens.
slides.alt_text: Stakeholders are grouped by who experiences, operates, enables, and captures value, with an economic-context caveat.

slides.title: One vendor-stated architecture. Four clear layers.
slides.limitations: Availability varies by model, region, language, channel, device, software, integration, and licensing. Capability evidence does not establish guest or financial outcomes.
slides.alt_text: Samsung is shown as a vendor-stated reference architecture organized into display, experience, integration, and governance layers.

slides.title: Confidence is part of the finding.

states.name: Direct fact
states.example: LYNK Cloud supports central device management.

states.name: Supported inference
states.example: Room controls can support a sense of control.

states.name: Modeled scenario
states.example: Avoided visits x local dispatch cost = potential savings.

contradictions: Usage is not satisfaction or causal value
Industry scale is not attributable revenue
slides.limitations: Vendor capability evidence can support a bounded pathway, but it does not prove the guest's perception or the property's financial result.
slides.alt_text: Three evidence states, four contradiction findings, and the major limit that capability evidence does not prove perception or financial outcomes.

slides.title: Audit the chain. Reuse the graph.
slides.body: Release 0.2.0 is an interactive Codex-assisted seed audit with disclosed human governance. Deterministic Python owns validation, counts, graph exports, and publication files.
slides.alt_text: Eight research stages, frozen release counts, the live HXG explorer URL, QR code, and an invitation to audit the evidence.
